pass_a_gloss: Spirit speaks through willing; world-hate; gold proved; Eve's pains turned; world unloved; oneness prayed.
pass_b_english: Take pattern through preparation unto martyrdom: the Spirit speaks through the willing — 'for it is not ye that speak.' (1 John 2:15–17) If the world hate you, know it hated Christ first; 'if ye were of the world, the world would love its own.' (Matthew 10:20,22) 'He that endureth to the end shall be saved.' (John 15:18–19) As gold proved in fire, our faith — 'much more precious than gold that perisheth, though proved by fire' (1 Peter 1:6–7) — shall be found unto praise at Christ's revelation. 'In pains thou shalt bring forth' (John 17:21) — Eve's sentence turned: through birth-pangs of confession unto the new birth. Love not the world, nor things in the world — 'for all in the world, lust of flesh, lust of eyes, pride of life, is not of the Father.' (Genesis 3:16) Be one, as Christ prayed 'that they all may be one' — one soul in the contest, washed by blood-baptism at the heavenly altar.
